title: confiture seed apply --format json
description: Result of applying the seed files in order, one savepoint per file (ApplyResult.to_dict). A file that fails without --continue-on-error rolls the run back and writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json, SEED_001) instead of this shape; with --continue-on-error (or seed.continue_on_error) the run keeps the files that applied, this shape reports the ones that did not, and the exit code is 0. Per-file progress goes to stderr.

total.description: Seed files selected under the seeds directory (after --profile); 0 when there were none.

failed.description: Files that failed; non-zero only under --continue-on-error.

failed_files.description: The failed files, in apply order, each by its path below the seeds directory (common/01_users.sql), the path a --profile glob matches; empty if none failed.

seed_profile.description: The seed profile applied (--profile, a key of seed.profiles in the environment config); null when every seed file was applied.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
